title: ExtractionResult
description: The data extraction results for a processed document, including all extracted fields, tables, and their confidence scores.

document_id.description: The identifier of the source document

template_id.description: The extraction template that was applied

extraction_method.description: The AI method used for extraction

overall_confidence.description: The overall confidence score for the extraction (0.0 to 1.0)

fields.description: The list of extracted fields with values and confidence scores

requires_review.description: Whether any extracted values fall below the confidence threshold and require manual review

extracted_at.description: The date and time the extraction was performed
